feature: Typed v3 EDS resource validation and reference-owned application channel publication

behavior.resource: bounded numeric TCP IPv4/IPv6 ClusterLoadAssignment parser retains dense priority/locality/endpoint weights, supported health states, additional address groups and normalized drop categories; validates duplicate locality/address identity, endpoint weights and priority sums
behavior.projection: priority_experimental -> xds_wrr_locality_experimental -> caller-selected endpoint child policy; exact length-prefixed locality identity and independent endpoint/locality weights; UNKNOWN/HEALTHY serving with DRAINING retained in typed resource
behavior.multi_address: additional addresses remain one logical endpoint and race complete HTTP/2 connections under a single deadline using the common connection-race owner
behavior.publication: ADS token/type checked and every resource decoded before selected assignment publication; invalid resource leaves prior topology/revision and ADS version unchanged; successful publication advances accepted ADS version before ACK output
behavior.deletion: valid SotW omission publishes an empty target, preventing new RPC admission and acknowledging the version
behavior.lifetime: optional SharedChannel.Update.target_lifetime descriptor retains generated target storage in canonical inventory and source/worker owners, including suspended/retained children; caller can release Snapshot immediately after publication
behavior.identity: path/key/host strings compare by content across owned snapshots, so unchanged ordinary endpoint connections are reused
behavior.priority_fix: pending priority jobs retain and wake a provisional selected worker; cached selections are checked against the currently selected priority and invalidate on higher-priority recovery
behavior.rollback: candidate parse/projection/channel allocation failure does not publish its target or retain provisional ownership
behavior.structure: cohesive EDS decode/target/apply modules plus explicit target-lifetime module and nearby resource/socket/priority tests

targeted_debug.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC EDS' -Dtest-filter='gRPC priority cached' --summary all

regressions: typed health/locality/endpoint weight and additional-address decoding; unknown/unhealthy filtering and missing locality-weight omission
duplicate locality/address, priority gaps, uint32 sum and zero endpoint-weight rejection
bounded bytes/localities/endpoints and malformed protobuf; UDP address rejection
length-prefix path collision prevention, pure snapshot allocator rollback and retained descriptor lifecycle
caller releases its Snapshot after publication; subsequent RPC and equal-snapshot reuse still succeed
config-only update retains target owner and active source references
logical multi-address endpoint reaches healthy alternate under one original deadline
channel update allocation failure preserves revision and leaves resource refs unchanged
pending priority selection invalidates a cached lower-priority worker after high recovery
official EDS protobuf over real ADS publishes initial 1:3 and restored 3:1 locality routing; 20 fallback calls all reach priority 1
invalid official resource NACK retains prior revision/version and valid SotW omission deletes backend admission
820 independent grpc-js application calls have exact payload/count agreement and one HTTP/2 session per backend

remaining_scope: Nonzero EDS drop execution is rejected until cluster-impl admission is implemented; remaining endpoint metadata/override-host/health/stale-policy integration, LDS/RDS/CDS route handling and bootstrap/failover/expiry/Delta xDS remain open, along with the overall cross-protocol objective.
